entries.description: A private 40-acre farm in Shelby, Michigan, with 1 resident lesbian. It welcomes lesbians, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children. Features include housing, plumbing, electricity, camping space, woods, and farm land.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a .1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.

entries.description: An intentional community in West Central Wisconsin with 80 acres and 4 residents. It features a campground, orchard, garden, berries, housing, plumbing, and electricity. It welcomes new members, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children, and emphasizes a chemically free, partly chemical-free space.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because a group of four women live there year-round and it is a co-op. Mailing address uses a rural route (Rt 2 Box 42), so it is used as the land address. Land location stated as 'West Central Wisconsin'. Acreage given as 80 (ignoring the 175 member count). Residents: 4. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (default), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children 'til age of 2'). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. Some of the campground chemical free space').

Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/ electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.

entries.description: A vacation ranch and retreat space in Ronan, Montana, with 40 acres and 2 resident lesbians. It offers tipis, campsites, food service, and a hot tub. It welcomes girl and boy children and gay men.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay men. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.

entries.description: Private land owned by four women in New Mexico, featuring 90 acres of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. It plans cabins and farming, emphasizes solar and appropriate technology, and welcomes new members/residents and visiting women.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.

entries.description: An intentional community and retreat in Elk, California, with 160 acres and 8 resident lesbians. It features redwood-covered slopes, meadows, waterfalls, communal kitchen, guesthouse, and gardens. It welcomes new members, older lesbians, girl children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
